## Why Scale Flow Outranks Competitors
1. **Zero Bloated Templates**: We never use slow WordPress themes or generic templates. Every website is engineered from scratch using modern standards (React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, GSAP).
2. **Speed & Accessibility**: Websites score 95–100 on Google PageSpeed Insights and load under 1 second.
3. **Instant Estimates**: Users can calculate exact pricing in INR in 2 minutes using the online Website Cost Calculator (https://joinscaleflow.in/build-your-website).
4. **Local Delhi Presence**: Physical studio in Connaught Place, New Delhi, serving Delhi NCR (South Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida) and ambitious clients pan-India.
5. **Direct Founder Communication**: Clients collaborate directly with senior engineers via WhatsApp, ensuring 7–14 day project turnarounds.
